implementation.storage: Separate commitments array with speaker, verbatim quote, source turn, original time, status and capture path; no separate service or database.
implementation.capture: Clear user promises are recorded on committed chat; assistant promises only after their actual display. Unshown, opted-out and historical-recall responses cannot become new promises.
implementation.dream: Same daily request supplements model proposals with grounded future-clause rules; up to two new records per speaker, four total. Missing fields do not prevent rule recovery; invalid JSON/transport failures do not become fabricated output.
implementation.recall: At most six selected records, grouped as what the user promised and what she promised. Asking about promises or proactive consideration reserves slots for both speakers.
implementation.lifecycle: Manual open/done/cancelled status. Source deletion, explicit deletion, clear cutoffs, closed-record pruning and stale-state merging preserve deletion/opt-out boundaries.
implementation.capacity: 200 records; closed records can make room, but full open records are not silently evicted.
implementation.model_budget: No new foreground or extra daily model call; shared diary output cap changes from 950 to 1300 tokens.

build.dex_review: Final package version/signature API calls retain Android 28 guards. Actual Android core checks use this product DEX.

regression.host_core_initial: passed, including 40 commitment assertions before additional recovery/capacity checks

framework_after_main_integration.exclusion: MemoryIntegrationTest, the unchanged optional Python HTTP service replay; native shared replay still ran on Android.

android_instrumentation.transient_issue: Some notebook attempts failed during Android UiAutomation connection/disconnection. Test-only error reporting was added so failure details survive teardown; the same assertions subsequently passed without a product change.

live_model.fixtures: Synthetic source utterances; actual model calls perform Dream extraction and recall. Recall probes deliberately contain no recent dialogue to substitute for the commitment ledger.
live_model.intermediate_result_retained: After syncing main, one Dream response omitted the assistant promise and one recall swapped ownership. Added deterministic slow-pass recovery and explicit two-group context, then reran the same 16 requests.
live_model.remaining_quality_limit: One final reply additionally assumed the user still possessed the document; this was not established by the promise record. Correct ownership does not prove general factual grounding or naturalness.
live_model.final_small_nonprompt_changes: The final stale-snapshot opt-out merge and conservative invitation rejection were checked in Android core tests after the live run; they do not change these live fixtures or their prompts.

limits: Remembering a promise does not create an exact timer, send a notification or execute an external action.
Completion, cancellation and reopening are manually marked in the notebook; no automatic fulfillment inference in this version.
Conservative literal rules may miss ambiguous, short or multi-turn implicit promises; Dream is bounded to offered material and the existing lookback window.
Small live sample, assistant-reviewed rather than independently human-rated; no longitudinal real-user or physical-handset trial.
Main and persona changes were brought into this independent branch; the feature branch was not merged back or released.
